subject.title: feat: add opt-in telemetry for Windows node tool calls

question: Should this repository adopt the proposed node-tool telemetry contract—covering gateway and local-MCP invocations, finite failure categories, sandbox metadata, and failure-only logs—for export to a user-configured OTLP endpoint?
rationale: This is a product and privacy-boundary choice, not a mechanical correctness question: the implementation creates a durable operational-data contract that operators and downstream collectors may rely on.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract after proof
options.body: Keep the documented finite allowlist and require redacted current-head collector evidence for gateway and local-MCP behavior before merge.

options.title: Narrow the exported contract
options.body: Reduce or remove selected execution, sandbox, or failure fields before accepting the feature if their operational value does not justify the privacy surface.

options.title: Defer node-tool export
options.body: Pause this feature until the repository has a broader maintainer-approved telemetry schema for node execution diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the documented finite allowlist and require redacted current-head collector evidence for gateway and local-MCP behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository history points to this person as the closest adjacent owner for tray diagnostics and the Windows node execution surface.
